impact: Classification precedence left implicit: the table calls manifest-absence an ordinary first-run rebuild while the reset-crash analysis calls manifest-absence-with-residue a reset, and a conforming-but-unreferenced generation (the exact residue §4 promises after a crash between the generation and manifest commits) is unclassified. Fix: explicit precedence — manifest absent + truly empty skeleton ⇒ first-run rebuild; manifest absent + ANY residue ⇒ reset; manifest present + unreferenced generation ⇒ ordinary GC, never reset; fixtures for all three.
title: [edge-cases] Classification precedence left implicit: the table calls manifest-absence an ord
